instrument.name: DigCompEdu Check-In｜专业参与｜教师自评｜高教英文2023（PeerJ2024）

scores.label: Professional Engagement (area raw sum)
scores.description: 4 item-specific 0–4 responses summed without reversing; range 0–16. Descriptive self-report, not a validated standalone proficiency grade.

interpretations.headline: Professional Engagement: reflect on your current practice
interpretations.interpretation: These answers describe your own perception of practice in professional engagement. A higher raw sum means you selected options describing more digital engagement; it does not establish observed competence, student outcomes or teaching quality. Consider which practices worked for your learners and which depended on time, access or institutional support. Fewer opportunities to use technology do not make you a less capable teacher. There is no norm-based high/low category here.

guidance.text: Choose one communication task; try one appropriate channel and ask a colleague whether it made collaboration clearer.
If access, workload or support is limiting your options, record one specific need and discuss a feasible next step with an appropriate colleague or support team.

limitations: Higher-education English survey published by Ersoy et al. (2024), dated 2023-06-02; this is not the original school Check-In, SELFIEforTEACHERS32 or a validated Chinese edition.
Area separation and this complete-case missingness policy are project adaptations. Prefer the full original 22-item sequence; no standalone area validation or norm is claimed.
Self-report is affected by opportunities, resources and interpretation. Do not use for diagnosis, performance ranking, teacher accountability or unsupported comparisons.
